# `paper/tables/`

**What it is.** Table payloads of the article.

**Purpose in the repository.** `tables.json` holds the content of the fourteen tables; `paper/build_article.py` inserts them into the DOCX and `paper/validate_docx_only.py` checks every cell. Regenerated by `paper/build_results.py` from `paper/data/`.

**Files directly in this folder:** 1 (besides this README).  
Repository-wide status of every file: [`LEGACY_MAP.md`](../../LEGACY_MAP.md).
